title: Add client recommendation to coarsen readAt timestamp precision
description: readAt and lastReadAt are UTCDate (second resolution), enabling 'read at 2:47:03 PM' UI. The spec should recommend clients display coarsened representations (today/yesterday/earlier or hour-granularity) and SHOULD NOT expose sub-minute precision in UI. No data model change needed; this is a client behavior SHOULD in the spec prose. Affects draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md (ReadPosition section or Security Considerations) and jmap-chat-wss-guide.md.
close_reason: Added timestamp coarsening SHOULD to Read Receipt Privacy section (chat-00.md:1442)
